raw_response: {"diagnosis":"The DE-398 refactor on 2026-01-16 made silver_transactions derive txn_date from ingest_ts, which is always the day after txn_ts. That is why all 4582 POSTED rows have a mismatched date and the gold daily tables are bucketed by the wrong day. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the intended meaning.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
